Subject: RE: Missed MAP checkpoint — timeline slip + next steps

Marcus,

Thanks for flagging. I'll update the MAP doc to reflect a slipped checkpoint and propose an updated timeline for the integration milestones. Key changes to capture:
- Move "Data ingest smoke test" from 4/9 -> 4/16
- Push staging rollout window one week later to accommodate vendor validation
- Add a dependency: Orchard to provide redaction spec by 4/10 or we delay the staging tests

I'll draft the amended MAP and attach it to the reschedule confirmation. For the customer-facing reply, recommend we:
1) Acknowledge no-show politely and offer two tight options (one live, one async)
2) Share the updated MAP PDF and call out the new critical dates
3) Confirm ownership/next steps and a single point of contact (we should ask Orchard to confirm their redaction owner)

I'll prep the PDF now — will drop in Drive and attach to the confirmation.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
